title: Insurance Decision Record Audit Event
description: Hash-chained append-only ledger event describing which AI tool read which insurance application / claim / policy field, when, under which NAIC AI Model Bulletin (Nov 2023) governance basis, under which buyer-published Decision Card, and under what records-of-disclosure obligation. Covers the three primary insurance-AI decision surfaces — underwriting (issue / decline / rate), claims (approve / deny / amount), pricing / rating (continuous adjustments) — under one schema with kind enum branching. Designed to bridge ACORD (insurance-industry data standards) + state DOI examination semantics to the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite audit-stream spine.

event_id.description: UUID v7 or similar monotonic ID

source.description: The system that emitted the event (e.g. 'coastguard-policyadmin', 'vendori-claimstriage-3.x')

value.description: Tokenized policy / claim / application identifier — RAW policy number, applicant SSN, claimant SSN, and applicant / claimant name MUST NOT appear

acord_xref.description: ACORD form code or XML element reference (e.g. 'ACORD 80', '//ApplicationInfo/RiskAddress')

action.description: Action codes: C = Create, R = Read, U = Update, D = Delete, E = Execute

outcome.description: Outcome codes: 0 = success, 4 = minor failure, 8 = serious failure, 12 = major failure

principal.description: OPTIONAL — actor on whose behalf the AI tool acted (underwriter, claims adjuster, customer service rep)

logged_in_state_doi_record.description: Whether this access was logged in the insurer's state-DOI examination log

logged_in_fcra_dispute_log.description: Whether this access was logged in the insurer's FCRA dispute / reinvestigation log

purpose_of_use.description: Free-text purpose statement (e.g. 'underwriting decisioning', 'claims triage', 'rating engine input')

redaction_applied.description: Which fields were tokenized / hashed / redacted per the Decision Card's vault contract before reaching the AI tool

ai_recommendation.description: OPTIONAL — present on *.recommendation-produced + *.triage-produced + pricing.rate-recalculated events. Never autonomous on adverse-action — that always requires a human adjuster / underwriter.

reason_codes.description: Reason codes per the insurer's reason-code dictionary — NOT the FCRA / ECOA adverse-action statutory codes

human_adjudicator_required.description: MUST be true on any event whose recommendation could trigger an adverse-action notice (NAIC AI Model Bulletin governance expectation + 2024-2026 state DOI guidance)

decision_card_lifecycle.description: PROPOSED (see SPEC.md). OPTIONAL — required on insurance.decision-card.* kinds only. Tracks the post-issuance lifecycle of a previously-issued AI Claims Decision Card (reviewed / appealed / overridden / reissued / expired), bridging this event-access-log schema to the ai-claims-decision-card-spec card that governed the original decision.

spec.description: Detection key naming the sibling spec this event bridges to — same convention as claims_card_version / audit_stream_version elsewhere in the Suite

claims_card_version.description: Version of ai-claims-decision-card-spec the referenced card was issued under

card_hash.description: SHA-256 of the referenced Decision Card, e.g. sha256:<hex>

jurisdiction.description: US state code the lifecycle event is examined under (feeds state-insurance-ai-disclosure-tracker)
